sections.title: MANDATORY AVAILABILITY RULES · corrected with your feedback
sections.body: Do not equate missing stock information with sold out. Keep a live relevant product/ad listing in the shortlist when the target phone is not explicitly marked sold out, unavailable, discontinued, expired or deleted. Use stock.status=not_stated when availability is not explicit; never label it confirmed in stock. Use in_stock only for explicit target-specific availability, low_stock for a positive limited-quantity message. Recheck EVERY listed offer each run before ranking. If a check fails or is blocked, retain the existing record as check_failed with its last successful evidence/date and a visible stale warning; log the failure. New blocked/search-only discoveries belong in research history until the product can be inspected. Remove only on explicit target-specific negative availability or a separately documented reason such as outside location or budget. Never apply related-product Sold Out badges to the target phone. Keep Toyo HONOR400Pro excluded based on the user screenshot until that negative evidence is resolved by a fresh explicit positive status. Preserve removal evidence and retry. Stock not stated does not mean guaranteed inventory; confirm with the shop before travelling.

sections.title: KOKO support · a prominent buying criterion
sections.body: Scan the exact product/selected variant for KOKO text, logo, linked payment widget, accessible image alt, or a three-payment line tied to KOKO. Example: or 3 X LKR.51,666.67 with image alt Koko counts as product-specific evidence. Store koko.supported=true only with explicit evidence; use null for not stated, false only when explicitly not accepted. Never infer from an unlabeled 3-payment plan or another product. Merchant-wide official evidence can establish merchant support, but label scope=merchant and product eligibility/quote unconfirmed. Record exact evidence, source URL, checkedAt, monthly, total, extra fees, selected warranty/colour and whether total is actually confirmed. Display Supported, Not stated or Not supported prominently, with 3 x amount and advertised total where shown. Calculate only from known amounts and label rounding; do not invent fees. Prefer KOKO-supported offers when value/fit is similar. Missing KOKO evidence is a visible limitation, not proof of rejection.

sections.title: Colombo only · confirmed location filter
sections.body: User explicitly confirmed Colombo and nearby suburbs only; exclude Kandy/Akurana and every other out-of-area seller from the shortlist. Do not show an out-of-area offer as an alternative to buy. Log rejected findings, their source and reason. Original historical logs may retain old source references as audit evidence, never as recommendations. Verify the merchant pickup address; testing permission is a separate unknown until established.

sections.title: Daily workflow and complete research logging
sections.body: At 08:00 Asia/Colombo read profile/search/instructions/offers/recent logs JSON. Recheck all current offers, then search EVERY explicit target plus priority and worthwhile newer models. Log EVERY search query, filters/location, method and timestamp; every encountered product or ad result including unsuitable/over-budget/sold-out/out-of-area/duplicate/inaccessible results; record title, URL, any observed price/stock/KOKO/location, outcome, include/exclude/hold reason and failure. Separate snippets from opened pages and seller claims from verified facts. Do not omit unsuccessful searches or rejected offers. Store structured queries[] and findings[] in the append-only run log; include readable summaries so the dashboard presents everything. Preserve actual check times and previous values. A blocked check does not refresh lastSuccessfulCheckAt. No contacting sellers, cart mutations, reservations or purchases.

sections.title: Ranking and offer fields
sections.body: Ascending suitability rank #1 best fit: battery and camera, sustained performance/signal/OS, warranty/condition, full payable value and KOKO support. Deduplicate seller+model+storage+condition. Keep separate price and KOKO filters. Cash and installment totals are distinct. Capture variant/region/condition, source and shop address, cashPrice/from flag, KOKO evidence/monthly/total/fees, stock status/evidence/check date/last successful check, warranty/display-line cover, testing permission, used battery health/cycles/repairs and camera/battery tradeoffs. Do not represent a range/minimum as a chosen 256GB price. Do not promise 6–9h from80%to20%, OLED immunity, local applicability of foreign warranties or a network fix without evidence.

sections.title: Dashboard data and daily updates
sections.body: Canonical files: data/profile.json, search.json, instructions.json, offers.json and logs.json. Edit JSON, not HTML/app.js. active offers can have in_stock, low_stock, not_stated or check_failed status, honestly labelled. Keep negative/excluded records in history/logs only. Append logs for every run and finding. Run node build-data.mjs after updates, fix validation failures, then verify dashboard data. Original TXT files and originalText are frozen migration references, never current instructions.

sections.title: IN-STORE TEST / PURCHASE CHECKLIST
sections.body:
1. Obtain permission to test before payment and confirm refund/return terms.
   A display/demo unit does not prove the exact sealed unit is fault-free.
2. Obtain written local warranty issuer, service location, display-line coverage,
   duration, battery terms, exclusions and invoice with matching device identity.
3. Verify model, region, storage, IMEI consistency, network approval/status and
   local carrier compatibility. Avoid undocumented ROM conversions.
4. With your SIM, make calls, use mobile data, turn on hotspot to another device,
   navigate outdoors and take indoor/outdoor photos and video together for
   30-45 minutes if allowed. Compare signal with Pixel in the same location.
   Record battery percentage and temperature/comfort; short tests cannot certify
   a full 6-9-hour day. Seek a return window for a complete real-use test.
5. Check all cameras, focus/OIS, audio, speakers/mics, USB port, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth,
   GPS, biometrics, touch and full-screen grey/white/red/green/blue patterns.
6. Used iPhone: inspect Battery Health, Parts and Service History, Face ID and
   carrier lock. Have seller remove Find My/Activation Lock, erase and activate
   with you; reject Locked to Owner, remote management or unexplained Unknown parts.
   High battery health alone does not prove a genuine battery or untouched phone.
7. Get the exact cash and KOKO totals in writing, including every fee/accessory;
   confirm your KOKO limit and eligibility before committing.
Apple buying guide: https://support.apple.com/en-mide/104999
Apple repair history: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102658

originalText:
PHONE SEARCH INSTRUCTIONS
Updated: 17 October 2026. Schedule: daily 08:00 Asia/Colombo.
Folder: [local project folder]

FILE RESPONSIBILITIES
phone_instructions.txt - workflow, verification, ranking, logging and test rules.
phone_search.txt       - personal needs and models to search.
phone_offers.txt       - current stock-verified offers ONLY.
phone_logs.txt         - append-only run history, additions, price/rank/status changes.
Read these files before each run. Keep their roles separate.
HOW STORE FINDINGS ARE SORTED
Ascending suitability rank: #1 = best offer for your needs, not lowest price.
Battery and camera are joint priorities, followed by sustained performance,
signal/heat behaviour, condition/warranty confidence and full payable value.
Lower total price breaks close ties. Rankings are informed judgments, not lab scores.
A separate ascending cash-price index appears below.
Deduplicate seller + model + storage + condition; update instead of duplicating.
Retain old prices in phone_logs.txt. Remove sold-out/expired offers and retain their records in phone_logs.txt.
Use each offer's actual first-seen and last-checked timestamps.

LOCATION, CONDITION AND EVIDENCE RULES
Colombo and test-before-payment remain requirements. Dehiwala qualifies as a
Colombo-area lead. Akurana/Kandy is outside the requested location: keep any such
listing in the logs as an excluded out-of-area lead, never promote it.
Over-budget negotiable asking prices stay in logs until a qualifying final
quote is obtained. Never assume negotiation will succeed or KOKO has no surcharge.
Used iPhone health, cycles, first-use date, repair history, activation, Face ID and
network lock must be checked on the actual handset. Health alone is insufficient.
Do not contact sellers, reserve or purchase without explicit user authorization.
Treat pasted findings dated 13 October as user-provided historical research.
Preserve original dates and claims, do not relabel them as freshly verified.
Never claim the current task re-opened a page unless it actually did.

DAILY WORKFLOW
Read phone_instructions.txt, phone_search.txt, phone_offers.txt and recent phone_logs.txt entries. Search all first-group and explicit user
models plus worthwhile secondary/newer options. Use manufacturer specs for
hardware and direct merchant listings for prices; preserve marketplace ads as
unverified leads in phone_logs.txt until positively stock-verified. Record unsuccessful verification.
Update findings with exact variant/region/condition, seller and address, cash,
KOKO total/fees/installments, stock, warranty issuer/duration/display cover,
test-before-pay status, source URL, first seen and last actually checked date.
Deduplicate, preserve price history, sort ascending suitability rank (#1 best),
and maintain a separate ascending cash-price index.
Keep phone_search.txt for requirements and model targets; store seller-specific discoveries only in
phone_offers.txt. Improve model priorities when evidence changes, but retain the
explicit user models above. Do not overwrite user preferences with seller claims.
The original endurance goal is 6-9h from 80% to 20%; pasted earlier assessments
also mention 8-12h. Retain 6-9h as the baseline and 8-12h as a stretch aspiration,
not a confirmed new requirement or a promised capability.
IN-STORE TEST / PURCHASE CHECKLIST
1. Obtain permission to test before payment and confirm refund/return terms.
   A display/demo unit does not prove the exact sealed unit is fault-free.
2. Obtain written local warranty issuer, service location, display-line coverage,
   duration, battery terms, exclusions and invoice with matching device identity.
3. Verify model, region, storage, IMEI consistency, network approval/status and
   local carrier compatibility. Avoid undocumented ROM conversions.
4. With your SIM, make calls, use mobile data, turn on hotspot to another device,
   navigate outdoors and take indoor/outdoor photos and video together for
   30-45 minutes if allowed. Compare signal with Pixel in the same location.
   Record battery percentage and temperature/comfort; short tests cannot certify
   a full 6-9-hour day. Seek a return window for a complete real-use test.
5. Check all cameras, focus/OIS, audio, speakers/mics, USB port, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth,
   GPS, biometrics, touch and full-screen grey/white/red/green/blue patterns.
6. Used iPhone: inspect Battery Health, Parts and Service History, Face ID and
   carrier lock. Have seller remove Find My/Activation Lock, erase and activate
   with you; reject Locked to Owner, remote management or unexplained Unknown parts.
   High battery health alone does not prove a genuine battery or untouched phone.
7. Get the exact cash and KOKO totals in writing, including every fee/accessory;
   confirm your KOKO limit and eligibility before committing.
Apple buying guide: https://support.apple.com/en-mide/104999
Apple repair history: https://support.apple.com/en-us/102658



LOGGING - APPEND ONLY
Append a timestamped entry in Asia/Colombo for every run, including no-change,
partial and failed runs. Never erase or rewrite earlier entries.
Record run start/end, outcome (completed/partial/failed/no-change), models and
sources searched, offers added/updated/archived, old -> new prices/ranks/statuses,
verification failures, reasons for ranking changes, files changed and next steps.
Use seller+model+storage+condition+URL to identify an offer; never log sensitive
device identifiers, account information or payment details.
Distinguish user-provided historical claims, online verification and seller
confirmation. A file edit is not a new search and must not refresh offer timestamps.
If interrupted or blocked, append the failure details when possible.
Save findings before logging successful completion. Log partial changes honestly.
Search and update findings every day. Notify only on meaningful new offers,
price drops, ranking changes, failures or required user action; otherwise stay quiet.
Do not buy, reserve, contact sellers or send messages without user authorization.
Preserve user requirements. Update model targets only when new evidence supports it.

MANDATORY STOCK CHECK - USER UPDATE 17 OCTOBER 2026
This overrides earlier permission to keep unverified/watchlist/archive seller
offers in phone_offers.txt. That file is now ONLY for current stock-verified offers.
Before adding ANY offer, open the seller's live product/ad page and inspect the
exact model, storage, condition, colour and warranty variant. On variable products,
select available options read-only and check the resulting availability message.
Require explicit positive availability for the exact offered unit/variant.
A price, active advertisement, search snippet, generic shop pickup, order button,
or absence of "out of stock" is NOT sufficient. Stock badges on unrelated
recommended products must NEVER be applied to the target phone.
If extracted/cached text omits stock, use the live browser and inspect visible
availability. Conflicting evidence is UNCONFIRMED until resolved. A user screenshot
showing out of stock must not be overridden by an order button or stale snippet.
Do not add items to a cart, reserve or contact sellers as a stock test.

EVERY RUN: re-open EVERY currently listed offer and verify stock again BEFORE
ranking or searching for additions. Record URL, exact selected variant, check time,
method and verbatim product-specific availability wording.
If sold out, unavailable, discontinued, preorder/backorder only, expired/deleted,
remove the offer from phone_offers.txt AND its cash-price index immediately.
If blocked, ambiguous, inaccessible or stock otherwise unconfirmed, also remove
from current offers, log STOCK_UNCONFIRMED, and retry on later runs.
Do not carry an old in-stock check forward as proof of today's stock.
Low stock explicitly available ("only 1 left") remains eligible with quantity
warning; log LOW_STOCK. Never call unknown stock or available low stock sold out.
For an actual out-of-stock removal log "Removed listed phone due to unavailable
stock" (user's requested low-stock removal), and preserve the exact reason.

Keep removed/unverified seller records and prior offer details ONLY in
phone_logs.txt, not watchlists/archive sections in the current offer list.
Recheck previous unresolved/removed leads from recent logs when practical each run;
only restore after fresh positive variant-specific stock evidence, recording
RESTORED and its new rank. Keep phone_search.txt as the model search plan.
A stock-verified online listing is not seller-confirmed inventory or a guarantee
of testing permission. Mark these separate checks honestly.
If nothing qualifies, write "No stock-verified offers currently listed" without
inventing entries or weakening the rule. Then re-sort remaining eligible offers.
Log every removal/restoration/status change with old/new status and source/time.
